mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accounts (acct_number, cust_id, product_code, branch_code, acct_status, opened_date, closed_date, overdraft_limit, term_days, dormancy_date) VALUES (#{a.acctNumber}, #{a.custId}, #{a.productCode}, #{a.branchCode}, #{a.acctStatus}, #{a.openedDate}, #{a.closedDate}, #{a.overdraftLimit}, #{a.termDays}, #{a.dormancyDate})
